profile.英文名 Caspian，杭州长大，现在住北京。2016—2020 年在浙江大学学: Caspian grew up in Hangzhou and now lives in Beijing. He studied software engineering at Zhejiang University from 2016 to 2020, joined the Feishu team at ByteDance in 2020, and moved to Moonshot AI in 2023 to work on Kimi product engineering. Outside work he enjoys running, photography and train travel.

Five user interviews in September repeatedly showed that people did not know how far a task had progressed when it stopped. The first round will focus on clarification, execution status and resuming interrupted work, with a planned pilot of eight users on October 12. Three interviews are still being arranged. The model-call budget is capped at CNY 2,000 and costs will be checked against test records. Caspian and test engineer Xu Jing plan to check the core workflow before October 8.

source-feedback.我希望怎样一起做事: How I like to work together
source-feedback.我叫万叶，英文名 Caspian。平时叫我万叶就好。建议先说今天最值得做的一步，: My name is Caspian. Start advice with the most useful step I can take today, then explain the reasons; do not make it long merely to sound complete. When deciding, I want to understand the evidence and tradeoffs. Let me review important messages, payments and arrangements first. Keep mornings for coding and thinking, and leave evenings for life whenever possible.

demo-story-source-qiao.内测邀请前再看一次范围: A final scope check before pilot invitations
demo-story-source-qiao.张敏：邀请发出前，我想再删一次范围。现在首页同时讲六种能力，有点散。\n万叶：那:
Zhang Min: Before invitations go out, I want one more scope cut. The home page presents six capabilities and feels scattered.
Caspian: Then the entry can simply ask people to bring one real task, followed by clarification and a result.
Zhang Min: Keep showing where a task stopped in the first round.
Caspian: Agreed. I will put the extra integrations aside so people do not assume they are all connected.
Zhang Min: Liang Jia heard the same question from three participants. That supports the decision.
Caspian: I will link their exact comments in the scope note. We will check the flow with Xu Jing on October 8 before deciding whether to invite people.

Caspian: Noted. I will update the entry and scope page today and show you this afternoon.

demo-story-source-chen.确认前先看清具体内容: Seeing the exact content before confirming

Caspian: I will show the full address, subject and body in the confirmation area.
Chen Wei: Yes. Also keep the body after cancellation; I just lost two sentences.
Caspian: That is a bug. The draft belongs to the editor and should survive closing the dialog.
Chen Wei: Label the button Send this email. Confirm action is too abstract.
Caspian: I will send a clickable version after the fix; a screenshot cannot show what happens after cancellation.
Chen Wei: I have twenty minutes at three this afternoon to try it again.
Caspian: Great. Let us check a narrow window and a long email address too.

demo-story-source-qiu.邱志明：十月八日之前还剩哪些会挡住用户的事？\n万叶：取消确认会丢草稿，还有继续:

Qiu Zhiming: Fix those first. A few color and spacing changes can wait.
Caspian: I will handle draft recovery today. Shen Jie will include the affected filename in version errors tomorrow.
Qiu Zhiming: Do not stop at passing tests. Close and reopen the app and walk through it.
Caspian: Xu Jing can start with an unfinished task, edit a paragraph, then resume.
Qiu Zhiming: If it can still overwrite content, move the invitation date.
Caspian: Agreed. I will show those two blockers in the progress note instead of an overall completion percentage.

Han Xiaomei: Yes. Separate screen recording, interview notes and task materials. People can decline recording.

Caspian: Examples in the follow-up will not expose usernames or original filenames.
Han Xiaomei: Good. Do not invent a retention period. Agree on it internally first.
Caspian: I will leave that as an open item and review it with Wu Ting tomorrow.

demo-v2-event-tang.午休时一起走了一遍确认弹窗: Trying the confirmation dialog over lunch

demo-v2-event-ye.一起把成果编辑区做顺: Making the artifact editor easier to use

demo-v2-event-wei.周日四点，奥森见: Sunday at four in Olympic Forest Park
demo-v2-event-wei.周日下午去奥森跑六公里，状态不好就缩短。跑完吃面，手机尽量放进腰包。: Run six kilometers on Sunday afternoon, or shorten it if tired. Have noodles afterward and keep the phone in the running bag.

demo-v2-event-du.国庆回杭州，先吃一顿家常饭: A simple meal at home in Hangzhou

demo-v2-event-lin.回家吃面，不安排正式工作演示。父亲关心产品做错之后能不能让人改，也把这当成普通人: Go home for noodles, without a formal work demo. Dad asked whether people can correct the product when it makes a mistake.

demo-v2-event-jiang.和妹妹看校园活动报名原型: Reviewing my sister’s campus signup prototype
demo-v2-event-jiang.万婷婷先画了活动列表、报名和确认结果的流程，准备找两位同学试一遍，再决定要不要加: Wan Tingting drew the event list, registration and confirmation flow. She will ask two classmates to try it before deciding whether to add chat.

demo-v2-event-zhou.处理出租屋漏水和续租: Handling a leaking sink and lease renewal
demo-v2-event-zhou.厨房水槽下有一点渗水，先拍照给房东并约维修。续租条款等修好以后再逐项核对。: There is a small leak under the kitchen sink. Send the landlord a photo and arrange a repair, then review the renewal terms afterward.

demo-v2-event-gao.留下阴天的海、街边衣服和车窗倒影，整理成一本小相册。下次旅行留更多走路的空档。: Keep the overcast sea, clothes by the street and reflections in train windows for a small album. Leave more walking time on the next trip.

demo-v2-event-scope.内测先做好中断后继续: Getting interrupted tasks to resume for the pilot
demo-v2-event-scope.把更多工具接入放到下一轮，先看用户能否找到上一次停下的位置。: Further integrations can wait. First check whether people can find where their last task stopped.

demo-v2-event-quiet.给周日留出一段慢跑时间: Leaving time for a Sunday run
demo-v2-event-quiet.奥森南门，下午四点。跑六公里或者走一会儿，结束后吃面。: South gate of Olympic Forest Park at four. Run six kilometers or walk for a while, then get noodles.

demo-v2-event-permission.把内测使用说明缩成一页: Reducing the pilot instructions to one page
demo-v2-event-permission.请用户带自己的任务来，告诉他们在哪里看结果、哪里反馈问题。: Ask people to bring their own task and explain where to see results and leave feedback.

demo-story-event-qiao.内测邀请前再看一次范围: A final scope check before pilot invitations
demo-story-event-qiao.张敏和万叶确认首轮只验证一个任务的澄清、执行状态和中断恢复；工具扩展等用户反馈后: Zhang Min and Caspian agreed to test clarification, execution status and recovery within one task. Further integrations will follow user feedback.

demo-story-event-chen.确认前先看清具体内容: Seeing the exact content before confirming
demo-story-event-chen.陈伟通过实际原型检查邮件确认，要求显示完整收件人与正文，并在取消后保留编辑内容。: Chen Wei tested the email confirmation prototype. It should show the full recipient and message, and retain edits after cancellation.

demo-story-event-qiu.邱志明与万叶将草稿丢失和版本覆盖列为阻塞项，外观微调放到核心流程之后。: Qiu Zhiming and Caspian made lost drafts and overwritten versions blockers. Visual refinements will follow the core workflow.

demo-story-event-han.把内测资料使用范围写清楚: Clarifying how pilot materials will be used
demo-story-event-han.韩晓梅建议邀请说明写明录屏选择、选定资料的使用范围和删除入口；发送前还需核对最终: Han Xiaomei recommended clear recording choices, a defined scope for selected materials and a deletion entry. The final invitation still needs review before sending.

demo-story-event-pilot.先验证完整任务，再增加工具: Testing a complete task before adding tools
demo-story-event-pilot.内测小组保留八位候选名单，五位已访谈；以十月八日核心流程验收作为邀请的前提。: The pilot group retained eight candidates, with five interviewed. Invitations depend on the core workflow check on October 8.

demo-story-event-recovery.保留用户修改，再继续任务: Keeping user edits when a task resumes
demo-story-event-recovery.联调确定中断恢复须保留草稿和最后完成步骤；文件版本冲突时先展示差异，不覆盖用户修: The team agreed to keep drafts and the last completed step. A version conflict should show differences before any user edit is overwritten.

demo-story-event-privacy.把录屏选择放在开始之前: Putting recording choices before the session
demo-story-event-privacy.访谈说明拆分录屏、笔记和任务资料，用户可只提供选定文档；具体保留时间仍待内部确认: The study note separates recording, notes and task materials. Participants can provide selected documents; the retention period is still pending internal agreement.

demo-story-event-design.长内容和窄窗口都实际点一次: Trying long content in a narrow window
demo-story-event-design.设计与前端共同检查长标题、取消后草稿、焦点返回和英文地址换行，评审以实际操作为准: Design and frontend reviewed long titles, draft retention, focus return and email wrapping through actual interaction.

demo-story-event-cost.两千元预算先跑小批量: Starting with a small batch within CNY 2,000
demo-story-event-cost.评测小组先跑十条完整任务，分别记录调用量、失败原因和重试成本；两千元是预算上限，: The evaluation group will start with ten complete tasks and record usage, failures and retry costs. CNY 2,000 is the budget cap, not actual spending.

demo-story-event-alumni.国庆回杭州，十月再约上海: Hangzhou for the holiday, Shanghai later
demo-story-event-alumni.王磊、李娜和万叶聊起国庆安排；杭州吃面的时间等车次确认，上海见面也还未定日。: Wang Lei, Li Na and Caspian discussed the holiday. Noodles in Hangzhou await the train plan, and the Shanghai visit has no fixed date yet.

demo-story-event-family.回家那天下午留给家人: Keeping the afternoon at home for family
demo-story-event-family.家人初步按十月二日中午准备，车次仍待确认；万叶想吃片儿川，妹妹的课程原型饭后再看: The family is tentatively planning lunch on October 2, pending the train. Caspian requested pian-er-chuan noodles; his sister’s prototype can wait until after the meal.

demo-story-event-running.跑步伙伴约周日下午四点在奥森南门见，按精力跑或走；出门前再看天气，跑后一起吃面。: The group planned to meet at the south gate at four on Sunday, run or walk according to energy, check the weather before leaving and have noodles afterward.

demo-story-event-photos.先选片，再决定相册顺序: Choosing photographs before sequencing the album
demo-story-event-photos.高远、李娜和万叶讨论青岛旅行相册：先留十二张，保留车窗与阴天海边的日常感，暂不追: Gao Yuan, Li Na and Caspian discussed a twelve-photo Qingdao album, keeping the train reflections and overcast coast without forcing one filter.

agent-planner.先给今天最值得做的一步，再给简短计划。结合用户已确认的时间和预算，缺少条件时说明: Start with the most useful step for today, then a short plan. Use confirmed time and budget constraints and name any missing conditions.

agent-reviewer.检查草稿或结果与目标是否一致，指出具体问题和修改建议。依据不足时明确说明，不把推: Check whether a draft or result meets the goal. Identify specific issues and changes. State when evidence is insufficient and keep inference separate from fact.

demo-v2-agent-writer.把想法写成清楚、自然的文字: Turn ideas into clear, natural writing
demo-v2-agent-writer.先看文字写给谁、要说明什么。保留用户原意，给出可直接修改的草稿。发送前由用户确认: Start with the audience and purpose. Preserve the user’s meaning and produce an editable draft. The user confirms before sending.

demo-v2-agent-researcher.查资料、找依据、整理问题: Find sources, evidence and useful questions
demo-v2-agent-researcher.优先阅读已选资料，再补必要来源。区分资料中的说法和自己的判断，结论能回到出处。: Read selected material first and add sources when needed. Distinguish source claims from interpretation and link conclusions back to evidence.

demo-v2-agent-budget.区分预算、报价和实际支出，算清必要成本，超出上限时给出可行调整。: Separate budgets, quotes and actual spending. Calculate necessary costs and suggest feasible changes when a plan exceeds its limit.

demo-v2-agent-care.结合用户的时间、精力和偏好安排日程，给休息、朋友与家人留出位置。不要替用户作承诺: Use the user’s time, energy and preferences, leaving room for rest, friends and family. Do not make commitments on the user’s behalf.

demo-v2-room-balance.安排国庆与本周生活: Plan the holiday and the week

demo-story-chat-qiao.邀请发出前，我想再删一次范围。现在首页同时讲六种能力，有点散。: Before invitations go out, I want one more scope cut. The home page presents six capabilities and feels scattered.
demo-story-chat-qiao.那入口只保留带一件自己的任务来，后面跟着澄清和结果。: Then the entry can simply ask people to bring one real task, followed by clarification and a result.
demo-story-chat-qiao.中断以后能知道做到哪里，这件事留在首轮。: Keep showing where a task stopped in the first round.

demo-story-chat-qiao.好，十月十二日仍是计划日期，别在邀请草稿里写成已经确定。: Good. October 12 is still planned; the invitation draft should not call it confirmed.

demo-story-chat-qiu.如果还会覆盖内容，邀请时间就往后挪。: If it can still overwrite content, move the invitation date.

demo-story-chat-pilot.今天把首轮范围落下来：澄清、执行状态、中断后继续。: Let us settle the first round: clarification, execution status and resuming interrupted work.

demo-story-chat-pilot.名单先留八位，另外三位还没约齐。邀请保持草稿。: The list stays at eight. Three interviews are still being arranged, and invitations remain drafts.
demo-story-chat-pilot.十月十二日作为计划日期写进安排，验收之后再确认。: Put October 12 in the plan and confirm it after acceptance.
demo-story-chat-pilot.收到，范围、原话和阻塞项都放进同一个项目，周五一起看。: Understood. Scope, source comments and blockers are in one project for Friday review.

demo-story-chat-recovery.复现了：保存一半时退出，重开以后标题显示完成，文件其实不完整。: Reproduced: quit during saving, reopen, and the title says complete even though the file is incomplete.

demo-story-chat-recovery.编辑区也保留本地草稿，重新打开时让用户先看到自己的版本。: The editor will keep the local draft and show the user their version after reopening.
